statistics.claim: Alphabet annual revenues exceeded $400 billion for the first time in 2025 (about $403 billion).
statistics.limitations: As reported; later filings may restate

statistics.claim: In Q4 2025 Google Search and other revenue was $63.1 billion, up 17%; Google Cloud revenue was $17.7 billion, up 48%; Google Services revenue was $95.5 billion; Subscriptions, Platforms and Devices revenue was $13.6 billion; Cloud backlog was $240 billion.
statistics.limitations: As reported; later filings may restate

statistics.claim: Alphabet expected 2026 capital expenditure of $175 billion to $185 billion as of its fourth quarter 2025 call; the range was raised to $195 billion to $205 billion on the second quarter 2026 call.

In the second quarter of 2026 Alphabet reported consolidated revenue of $119.8 billion, up 24%; Google Cloud revenue of $24.8 billion, up 82%, with a 35.6% operating margin; Google Services revenue of $95 billion and operating income of $39.5 billion; and Cloud backlog of $514 billion.

Alphabet raised 2026 capital expenditure guidance to $195 billion to $205 billion and said it expects capital expenditures to increase significantly in 2027; it expects to recognize just over 50% of Cloud backlog as revenue over the next 24 months.
statistics.limitations: Company guidance; a forecast that can change
